summary: The WelcomeStaffAdmin page provides an interface for staff administrators with functionalities like date selection and site filtering.
purpose: To manage staff administrative actions with calendar date selection and site filtering.

workflows.name: Refresh View
steps: Select a site and discipline from dropdowns.
Enter or select start and end dates.
Click on refresh button to update the view with selected criteria.

validations: Ensure end date is not earlier than start date.
